verdict.rationale: Statsig publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document for its Console API at a versioned public path, and the Console API docs link the spec and commit to keeping it current. The probe 404s were on docs-domain paths, so they do not contradict the api.statsig.com artifact. Missing for 10: no evidenced OpenAPI spec for the HTTP evaluation/event-logging API (only the Console API), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of downloading the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: api.statsig.com publishes the Console API's machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at the versioned path /openapi/20240601.json
Statsig keeps the OpenAPI spec for this API version up-to-date.
